name: @activepieces/piece-xquik
description: Search public X/Twitter posts, users, timelines, and trends for automation workflows.

auth.description: Create an API key in Xquik, then paste it here. API docs: https://docs.xquik.com/api-reference/overview

search_tweets.name: search_tweets
search_tweets.description: Search public X/Twitter posts with X query operators.

query.description: Search query. Supports keywords, hashtags, from:user, exact phrases, and X search operators.

queryType.description: Return latest posts or top engagement-ranked posts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sinceTime.description: Only return posts after this ISO timestamp.

untilTime.description: Only return posts before this ISO timestamp.

aiMetadata.description: Searches public X/Twitter posts matching a query, which supports keywords, hashtags, exact phrases, from:user, and X search operators. Use to find posts on a topic; set the result type to fetch the latest posts or top engagement-ranked ones, and optionally bound results by a time window. Read-only and idempotent.

get_tweet.name: get_tweet
get_tweet.description: Look up a public X/Twitter post by ID

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single public X/Twitter post by its numeric post ID. Use when you already have a tweet ID and need its full details. Read-only and idempotent.

search_users.name: search_users
search_users.description: Search public X/Twitter users by name or username.

query.description: Name, username, brand, or keyword to search for.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

aiMetadata.description: Searches public X/Twitter user accounts by name, username, brand, or keyword. Use to discover or disambiguate accounts before fetching a specific user or their posts. Read-only and idempotent.

get_user.name: get_user
get_user.description: Look up a public X/Twitter user by username or user ID

user.description: Username with or without @, or a numeric user ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single public X/Twitter user profile, identified either by username (with or without the @) or by numeric user ID. Use to resolve an account to its profile details. Read-only and idempotent.

get_user_tweets.name: get_user_tweets
get_user_tweets.description: List recent posts from a public X/Twitter user

user.description: Username with or without @, or a numeric user ID.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

includeReplies.description: Include reply posts in the timeline response.

includeParentTweet.description: Include parent post context when available.

aiMetadata.description: Lists a public X/Twitter user's recent timeline posts, identified by username (with or without the @) or numeric user ID. Use to read an account's activity; replies and parent-post context can optionally be included. Read-only and idempotent.

get_trends.name: get_trends
get_trends.description: Get X/Twitter trending topics by region

woeid.description: Yahoo Where On Earth ID. Use 1 for worldwide, 23424977 for US, 23424975 for UK, or 23424969 for Turkey.

count.description: Number of trends to return. Use 1-50.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches current X/Twitter trending topics for a region, selected via a Yahoo WOEID (default 1 for worldwide). Use to see what is trending in a given location. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

nl.Search public X/Twitter posts, users, ti: Zoek openbare X/Twitter posts, gebruikers, tijdlijnen en trends voor automatiseringsworkflows.
nl.Create an API key in Xquik, then paste i: Maak een API-sleutel in Xquik, en plak deze hier. API docs: https://docs.xquik.com/api-reference/overview
nl.Search public X/Twitter posts with X que: Zoek openbare X/Twitter berichten met X query operatoren.
nl.Look up a public X/Twitter post by ID: Een openbare X/Twitter post via ID opzoeken
nl.Search public X/Twitter users by name or: Zoek openbare X/Twitter gebruikers op naam of gebruikersnaam.
nl.Look up a public X/Twitter user by usern: Een openbare X/Twitter gebruiker opzoeken door gebruikersnaam of gebruikers-ID
nl.List recent posts from a public X/Twitte: Lijst van recente berichten van een openbare X/Twitter gebruiker
nl.Get X/Twitter trending topics by region: Download X/Twitter trending topics per regio
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Search query. Supports keywords, hashtag: Zoek zoekopdracht. Ondersteunt trefwoorden, hashtags, uit:gebruiker, exacte zinnen en X zoekoperatoren.
nl.Return latest posts or top engagement-ra: Retourneert laatste berichten of top engagement-ranked berichten.
Maximum aantal berichten om terug te sturen. Gebruik 1-200.
nl.Pagination cursor from a previous respon: Paginering cursor van een vorig antwoord.
nl.Only return posts after this ISO timesta: Geef alleen berichten terug na deze ISO tijdstempel.
nl.Only return posts before this ISO timest: Retourneer alleen berichten voor deze ISO tijdsaanduiding.
nl.Name, username, brand, or keyword to sea: Naam, gebruikersnaam, merk, of sleutelwoord om naar te zoeken.
nl.Username with or without @, or a numeric: Gebruikersnaam met of zonder @, of een numerieke gebruikers-ID.
nl.Include reply posts in the timeline resp: Antwoordberichten opnemen in het antwoord van de tijdlijn.
nl.Include parent post context when availab: Bovenliggende bericht context toevoegen indien beschikbaar.
nl.Yahoo Where On Earth ID. Use 1 for world: Yahoo Where On Earth ID. Gebruik 1 voor wereldwijd, 23424977 voor VS, 23424975 voor Groot Brittannië, of 23424969 voor Turkije.
Aantal trends om terug te komen. Gebruik 1-50.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.
nl.HEAD: HOOFD
